actions.title: Prove the next consumer used the changed memory
actions.acceptance: Retain a current producer, changed memory record and exact later reader in the chosen scope.

actions.title: Measure benefit across a repeated cycle
actions.acceptance: Link a later outcome back to the next signal and compare the result.
actions.rationale: No follow-up ticket is mapped in the recorded inputs.

operatingContext.statement: The internal team reports that its staging data is now in production.
operatingContext.implication: Reuse intact historical chains and complete the missing links through current team work.
operatingContext.evidenceBoundary: Migration does not change original execution scope or prove a new production consumer.

teamGuides.title: Use the existing correction in the next plan
teamGuides.ownership: SYN-17 owner: Casey. Reviewer and engineering roles below are proposed, not assigned.
teamGuides.startWith: Select an account with migrated memory and identify the expected correction.

steps.instruction: Read existing feedback and memory. Reuse a valid correction before creating another.
Recover the signal, run, changed memory and later reader. Retain staging origin and timestamps for migrated links.
If later use is missing, inspect the next needed production plan and attach the exact memory reference and dated reader.

completion: The existing chain is preserved with original environment and dates.
A post-move production consumer references the exact memory before current production reuse is claimed.
teamGuides.blocked: Assign the missing link and a follow-up ticket; keep repeated-benefit work explicitly unmapped.

teamGuides.title: Use an approved review correction
teamGuides.ownership: SYN-18 owner: Riley. SYN-19 is unassigned; proposed roles are not new assignments.
teamGuides.startWith: Choose an existing review and its exact output.

steps.instruction: Compare the review to the output and record the correction with its source.
Resolve SYN-19 approval before the changed review is used.
Join the approved finding, changed output and a dated later consumer.

completion: The approval, finding, changed output and exact later use are linked.
teamGuides.blocked: Keep the missing approval visible and name its owner; do not infer approval from migrated data.
